name: 95630 · Folsom, CA
findings: ZIP 95630 (Folsom) has 251 nonprofit organizations. 112 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 91 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95630 (Folsom) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
